body:
New apps2/mud/combat_formula.go replaces the flat hardcoded playerDamage=30/per-mob-MeleeDamage deterministic combat with real STR-scaled random player damage, DEX-based crit (1.5x), a shared server/rng.MarbleBagPick accuracy/evasion roll (pity always favors the player), and VIT-based reduction. New server/mob.Registry.ReadyToSwing split out of TickPlayer -- verified byte-for-byte unchanged behavior via regression test -- so apps2/mud can compute the real roll with access to job stats server/mob deliberately doesn't import. Mobs get a flat accuracy/crit baseline (real, named v0 answer to the open stat-block question). PvP duels deliberately untouched (separate mob-registry-based mechanic). 16 new tests. Live-verified twice: throwaway instance (real variance 24-28dmg vs flat 30, crits/evades on both sides, full kill/XP/loot/level-up flow unaffected) then real production (real variance, real evade, real KO flow correct stacked with an existing Poison DoT). Commits aaf5133/86fb69d/15b0339/3029f67/1115bec.

⚓ ☃
title: Real STR/DEX/VIT/AGI combat damage formula, marble-bag+pity live (Phase 4.5)
